title: The Effect of Progressive Relaxation Exercise on Adaptation to Old Age and Quality of Life.
brief_summary: The changes and limitations that occur in the aging process effect people's adaptation toold age. The quality of life of elderly individuals who have problems in adaptation to aging is negatively affected. This study aimed to assess the effect of effects of Progressive Muscle Relaxation on the adaptation levels and quality of life of the elderly living in nursing homes.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 65 years and above,
* Do not have a diagnosis of dementia and psychiatric disease by the doctor and have a mini-mental test score of 23 and above,
* There is no problem with communication

Exclusion Criteria:

* Having severe hearing or perceptual deficits that impaired communication
* Having dementia, Alzheimer's disease,
